observation.command:
cd /workspace
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "start objections -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/objections-management
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "start temporal-codec -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/temporal-codec
sleep 60
for i in 1 2 3; do
  a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18006/docs 2>/dev/null)
  b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18014/docs 2>/dev/null)
  echo "poll $i: objections=$a codec=$b"
  [ "$a" = "200" ] && [ "$b" = "200" ] && break
  sleep 40
done
